logp.method_description: Octanol-saturated water (OSW) and water-saturated octanol (WSO) were prepared from octanol and distilled water (overnight shaking; Vibramax 100, Heidolph Instruments). The stock solutions of 2, 4 and cisplatin were prepared as follows: complexes (1 mg) were ultrasonicated in 15 mL of OSW for 15 min, centrifuged and supernatants were collected. Aliquots of these solutions were added to WSO and shaken at ambient temperature for 1 h. After that, the aqueous layer was carefully separated. The platinum concentration was determined from OSW aliquots taken before ([Pt]OSWb) and after ([Pt]OSWa) partition by inductively-coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP–MS; Agilent ICP–MS spectrometer 7700 ×) with the obtained values corrected for the adsorption effects. logP = log([Pt]WSO/[Pt]OSWa) equation was used for the partition coefficients calculation; [Pt]WSO = [Pt]OSWb - [Pt]OSWa.
